digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage instrumentation
propositions: Pass-1 chunk/container/ISF functions discard per-call usage from runner results, blocking token totals and per-criterion request counts in batch outputs and sidecar.
Usage is not threaded through the call chain from sizing.pass1_with_ladder through passes functions to concurrent-futures collectors and into ProductionBatchRunner.outputs['_usage'].

Multi-criterion chunks and ladder-retry attempts require atomic API changes across all call sites (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval, prerequisites, production_batch_runner) to propagate usage pairs.
Coverage.metrics lacks input/output/cache token totals and per-criterion llm_call counts needed for data-driven criterion demotion decisions.
Sidecar payload must include per_call usage records and per_criterion attribution map under documented keys.
